component.name: resend
component.summary: Build networks and see why a packet arrives or stops

description.p: resend is a networking lab for the desktop. Hosts, switches and routers are put on a canvas and wired together; their addresses, gateways and routes are set in the inspector. A ping or a traceroute then plays out frame by frame, and every frame tells why it was sent, where it went and why it stopped.

ul.li: Ethernet, ARP, IPv4 with default gateways and static routes, ICMP Echo, Time Exceeded and Destination Unreachable
Faults while traffic flows: unplugged cables, disabled ports, devices powered off, changed addresses, switch loops
A timeline that goes back to any instant, and every frame field by field and byte by byte
Captures for Wireshark, networks saved to files, undo and redo
Guided labs whose goals are checked on the simulation, with steps, hints and a solution

description.p: All traffic stays inside the simulation: resend never touches the real network.
